name: The Thinktank
source:
In a strange laboratory, unusual experiments are taking place. The main objective, to recover the lost merfolk of old. Play as a variety of characters who encounter the mysterious merman, Vesper and uncover the secrets of the 'Thinktank'. 

[From [url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/the-thinktank]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个陌生的实验室里，正在进行不寻常的实验。主要目标是找回失落的人鱼。扮演各种角色，遇到神秘的人鱼Vesper，并揭开“智囊团”的秘密。

[来自[url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/the-thinktank]Itch.io[/url]]
